siteEffect.title: Tet effect

tet.name: Lunar New Year peach blossoms
tet.description: Peach blossom petals gently fall across the whole yp.vn website, with a blossom branch in the corner. Content stays clickable; no impact on speed or SEO.

siteEffect.delayNote: Saved. yp.vn will update within about 1 minute.
siteEffect.noPermission: View only. Banner management permission is needed to turn it on or off.
siteEffect.previewNote: Visitors get a small button to hide the effect; petals do not fall when the device asks for reduced motion.
